column1: # Key of BnF Francais 18009, f. 156: "Double du chiffre baille a monsieur le marquis de Treinel" (Gallica btv1b90638776, canvas 181).
# Read by one reader from the image img/fr18009/c181.jpg (one pass; (?) = doubtful). Sign names are ours. 22 letter columns: no J, K, U, W.

column4: note
column A, row 1: f with a crossbar and a curled foot
column A, row 2: delta (round d, top curls left)
column A, row 3: small o with a cross standing on it
column A, row 4: f- or t-like stem with a low crossbar and a hooked foot (?)
column B, row 1: g like a 9, short closed tail
column B, row 2: small c with a tick inside
column B, row 3: capital F
column C, row 1: h- or 3-like sign with a tail below the line
column C, row 2: delta with a stroke across its top
column C, row 3: small z or E with a short middle bar
column D, row 1: tall hook like J; a dot follows it on the sheet
column D, row 2: 5- or h-like sign with a flat bar on top
column D, row 3: small v or b with a bar across its top
column E, row 1: L with a loop (like a pound sign)
column E, row 2: small cross with two bars
column E, row 3: g with a long open tail
column E, row 4: plain pi
column F, row 1: e joined to n
column F, row 2: k
column F, row 3: g with a bar on top
column G, row 1: round c or e with a hook inside
column G, row 2: 4 with a bar through it
column G, row 3: heavy double f with a bar (?)
column H, row 1: p with a bar through the stem
column H, row 2: long s with a small hook at the top right
column H, row 3: d with a tall slanted ascender
column I, row 1: q with a straight descender
column I, row 2: 7 or Z with a bar and a hooked foot
column I, row 3: two short legs on a base bar
column I, row 4: phi
column L, row 1: small r or x with a dot
column L, row 2: two short curved strokes, like (( (?)
column L, row 3: two stems with a bar on top and a bar below
column M, row 1: 2 with a tail below the line
column M, row 2: double f with one crossbar
column M, row 3: r with a wavy stroke to the right
column N, row 1: s (like a small 5)
column N, row 2: short f or t with a crossbar
column N, row 3: 6 or xi with a bar across the top
column O, row 1: long s, no crossbar
column O, row 2: two joined long s (like 88)
column O, row 3: mu (stem with descender joined to u)
column O, row 4: phi with a tick at the top right
column P, row 1: z with a bar through its stem
column P, row 2: long s with small strokes through it
column P, row 3: A- or f-like sign with a bar (?)
column Q, row 1: plain o
column Q, row 2: eta or n standing on a 4 (?)
column Q, row 3: v with a bar through it
column R, row 1: epsilon or open 8 with a hooked top
column R, row 2: m on a base bar
column R, row 3: h with the right leg below the line
column S, row 1: v with a tall left stroke (nu)
column S, row 2: n or u on a base bar that runs to the right
column S, row 3: small oval with a bar through it
column T, row 1: gamma or y
column T, row 2: o joined to t
column T, row 3: small oval with a bar (very like S row 3)
column V, row 1: eta
column V, row 2: omega, often with a bar on top
column V, row 3: small H
column V, row 4: m with a bar through it
column X, row 1: a
column X, row 2: n with a bar through it (star-like)
column X, row 3: 7 with a bar
column Y, row 1: 6
column Y, row 2: round e-n with a bar through it
column Y, row 3: 8 with a bar
column Z, row 1: plain c (?)
column Z, row 2: 6 with a bar
column Z, row 3: 4 with two bars below
